'''Seleno Chandro''' was a [[Jaluku]] [[bounty hunter]] who formerly worked with the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor]], he gained a reputation for capturing [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] fugitives, which resulted in him becoming paranoid of reprisals from the [[First Order]]. In [[35 ABY]], he was among the many individuals who heeded the call of the [[Resistance]] to aid them in [[Battle of Exegol|defeating]] [[Darth Sidious]] and the [[Sith Eternal]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. After the Resistance and their allies triumphed, Chandro and many others returned to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] to celebrate.

==Biography==
Seleno Chandro was a [[Jaluku]]<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> [[bounty hunter]] who at one point was a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. Following the devastating defeat of the [[Galactic Empire]] at the [[Battle of Endor]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> in [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Chandro excelled at capturing Imperial fugitives. Having earned quite a reputation for capturing Imperials, he made sure to avoid contact with the [[First Order]] that rose out of the remnants of the Empire.<ref name="TROS VD" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IX|Tidian's appearance}}</ref> Chandro was no longer a member of the Guild and was one of many unaffiliated individuals<ref name="TROS VD" /> who answered the call of [[Resistance]] agents [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca]] to aid the Resistance in [[Battle of Exegol|defeating]] the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]] above the [[planet]] [[Exegol]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

Calrissian and Chewbacca led Chandro and the other volunteers through the [[hyperspace]] [[Galactic Barrier|anomalies]] of the [[Unknown Regions]] to Exegol, where they immediately engaged the Sith Eternal's fleet, the [[Final Order]], based there. Shortly after their arrival, the [[Starship|vessels]] of the Resistance and their allies were disabled by the [[Force lightning]] of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]]; however, they regained control once the [[Sith]] turned his attention to fighting the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]. The Resistance and its allies were ultimately victorious and Chandro was amongst those who returned to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] to celebrate. As the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] reunited with Chewbacca, Chandro stood with the [[droid]] [[AL1-L3]]. He later stood at the edge of the crowd cheering as the Resistance heroes Rey, [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Finn]] hugged.<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Seleno Chandro was an [[alien]] with [[Color|white]] skin and yellow [[hair]]. His reputation for capturing Imperials made Chandro paranoid of First Order reprisals and so he diligently avoided contact with them.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Chandro was well-armed and carried an [[A310 rifle]]. He wore a black [[Clothing|outfit]] that included a pair of [[glove]]s and a pair of threat-magnifying [[data goggles]]. He flew a modified [[D-wing fighter]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard_50.png|thumb|right|200px|Wizard 50 by Jake Lunt Davies]]
Seleno Chandro was created for the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Concept art of Chandro titled "Wizard 50" was created for the film by creature concept designer [[Jake Lunt Davies]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> The character was known internally as "Pointy Chin" or "Carrot Head," although Davies had a [[Wikipedia:Parsnip|parsnip]] in mind when designing him for the film.<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|JakeLuntDavies|status/1369427100357234693|[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|quote=Totally obscure SW alien of the week! Seleno Chandro the bounty hunter(of course) designed for #theriseofskywalker Known internally as Carrot Head or Pointy Chin, I actually had a parsnip in mind when I drew him. Man shrugging. Crazy.|archivedate=1369427100357234693}}</ref>
